what.text: People were displaced internally in Afghanistan and across borders as refugees and asylum seekers.
In 2025, IDMC recorded 4355147 people displaced by conflict or violence and 2591571 displaced by disasters.
In 2025, UNHCR recorded 3199023 displaced people inside the country and 2671560 refugees abroad.

why.text: Conflict episodes occurred between the Government of Afghanistan and groups including Taleban, NRF, AFF, and Hizb-i Islami-yi Afghanistan from 2003 to 2025.
The Government of Afghanistan also fought IS (Islamic State) from 2015 to 2025, and the Government of Pakistan in 2024 and 2025.
Disaster events were also recorded as reasons for internal movements.

when.text: Conflict-related internal displacement reported by IDMC rose from 297000 in 2009 to 4513270 in 2022.
New conflict movements were recorded at 723082 in 2021 and 168265 in 2025.

how.text: IDMC counts people living in internal displacement at the end of the year.
UNHCR counts internally displaced people whom UNHCR protects or assists at the end of the year.
The sources don't say how people traveled or where they reside.
